note: CORRECTION: early single-shot profiles read 248us and attributed 64% to SFPU sigmoid. Re-measurement showed 248us was a transient environmental effect (same config reproducibly 102us later), AND the per-phase zone wraps each helper INCLUDING its cb_wait_front, so a starved phase reads as a slow phase. True profile: no phase dominates (p2 21%, p4 17%, p7b 16%, p7c 14%, p1 12%); op is near DRAM roofline.

conclusion: sigmoid payload is REAL SFPU work (152us of 244us at B1/T640, 2.65x headroom); moving it to the PACK thread is 0.992x (small consistent regression) because MATH and PACK share ONE SFPU per Tensix and are lock-stepped by DEST half-sync

text: Route 1 (preserve fp32 sum-of-squares off DEST) requires an fp32 accumulator that bypasses DEST. Only candidate is the packer L1 accumulator; catalog row_reduce_accumulate records it as fp32-DEST-only hardware. If confirmed, route 1 is unavailable and route 2 (documented deviation) is the path.

Confirmed fp32-DEST-only in 3 places in examples/row_reduce_accumulate (README method table, program descriptor comment: a bf16 DEST corrupts the accumulate, accuracy row). Float32 cb_sumsq buys nothing under a narrower DEST. dest_accum_pairs is bf16-error reduction not fp32. Chain L1Accumulation is one-accumulator-per-chain vs P1 needing one per token. Route 1 closed.

Route 2: default_compute_kernel_config -> fp32_dest_acc_en=False with deviation docstring. _DEST_TILE_LIMIT hardcoded 4 -> _dest_tile_limit(fp32_dest_acc_en) over 4/8; GATE_DEST_TILES is now a request clamped per config so the fp32 override path keeps working. No kernel change needed.

Guard set paired in-process, median of 5: 1.2159x B1T32 / 1.2156x B1T128 / 1.2118x B1T640 / 1.1808x B8T640 / 1.2613x approx / 1.2807x lofi / 0.9999x fp32on-override. Ablation at both widths shows non-sigmoid remainder flat (91.6 vs 92.4us; 305.9 vs 305.3us) so the win is entirely the SFPU payload: 151.5->108.2us (1.399x) and 228.9->147.2us (1.555x).

Free rider GATE_DEST_TILES 4->8 measured and NOT taken: curve turns over at 4 (d4 1.0078/1.0046/1.0009 vs d8 1.0046/1.0044/0.9960 across B1T128/B1T640/B8T640). Knob keeps the doubled derived ceiling for R3; shipped value stays 4.
